text:
Maria (Support): :rotating_light: Customer reported repeated 5xx/timeouts for hosted inference endpoint /v1/generate, multiple customers impacted, high P50/P95 latency. Ticket IDs: #C-1421, #C-1423. Sample req IDs: r_7a3f2a, r_8b4d90. Repro steps attached from customer.

Tim (oncall): Acknowledged. Adding oncall. Looking at gateway metrics now — p95 spiking around 12:03 UTC. Can you paste request sample and headers?

Maria (Support): Pasting minimal repro (customer uses curl):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2.1", "prompt":"summary...","max_tokens":512}'
```

Responses intermittently return 502 or timeout after 30s. Customer sees long tail errors starting ~11:50 UTC. They also reported elevated error codes in EU region.

Alex (SRE): Seeing increased 502/504 on hosted-gateway in eu-west-1. Connection pools trending saturated, backend 5xx from inference runtime at the same time. Correlating with a spike in long requests (seqlen + streaming). Dumping a few proxy logs:

```
proxy: upstream write failed: broken pipe; req_id=r_7a3f2a; backend=runtime-12; conn=exhausted
```

Sasha (runtime): Runtime shows KV cache evictions and a higher-than-normal memory spike on a subset of pods. There was a recent quantized-model canary deployed at 11:40 UTC (deploy-bot recorded canary: deploy/quant-v2 -> 10%). Rolling back canary now to see if it improves.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated for deploy/quant-v2 at 12:12 UTC. Rolling to 0%.

Tim (oncall): Temp mitigation: enable routing fallback to stable model variant and increase gateway connection pool for eu-west. Nora, can you draft a customer update acknowledging issue and we can offer failover guidance?

Nora (Customer Success): Will draft comms. Also pinged top 3 impacted customers with suggested immediate mitigation: use model family alias (redwood-2-stable) or retry/backoff client-side. Draft link: https://redwood.internal/comm-drafts/C-1421

Alex (SRE): Implemented temporary routing rule at 12:18 UTC: requests >10s route to stable variants. Also bumped gateway pool max_conn from 1000 -> 1500 for eu-west and restarted a handful of frontends. Early signs: error rate dropping but latency still elevated.

Sasha (runtime): After rollback and extra pool, runtime pod errors decreased. I see autoscaler didn't spin up enough capacity due to a threshold mis-config (scaleTarget CPU 80% ignored because metric tag mismatch). Opening quick PR to fix autoscaler metric mapping.

Maria (Support): Customers report significant reduction in 5xx after 12:25 UTC. One customer still seeing intermittent timeouts — provided new req_id r_9c7e11.

Alex (SRE): Investigating the remaining timeouts; tracing shows a downstream auth call (authz cache) had a transient 429 from KMS/billing service which cascaded and triggered circuit breakers. We're adding an explicit fallback for auth cache misses to avoid blocking inference.

Sasha (runtime): Action items I'm taking now:
- revert quant canary fully (done)
- add circuit-breaker guard on auth calls (in progress)
- fix autoscaler metric mapping PR #3456

Tim (oncall): Ops action items (short-term):
- keep routing fallback enabled for 1h
- monitor p95 and error rate; revert pool bump after stabilization
- collect heapdumps from pods that spiked (Alex)

Nora (Customer Success): Customer comms sent at 12:40 UTC. Offering 2 days of credits and a post-incident technical call. Sharing timeline and mitigation steps in ticket #C-1421.

Maria (Support): Marking support triage as resolved for now — will keep thread open for postmortem.

ops-bot: Incident warroom created: IR-2023-1722334, severity P1. Oncall rotation: Tim. ChatOps link: https://chatops.internal/IR-1722334

Alex (SRE): Postmortem next steps (proposed):
1) Root cause analysis: quantify impact of quantized canary on memory/KV pressure and cascade to gateway. Check canary resource limits and perf profile mismatch.
2) Fix autoscaler metric mapping and runbook for scale anomalies.
3) Improve auth/cache fallback on runtime to return fast error instead of blocking.
4) Add a canary gating check for runtime memory/KV eviction telemetry before canary promotion.
5) Update customer-facing runbook and add targeted alerting for proxy connpool saturation and KMS 429s.

Sasha (runtime): I'll own 1 & 4. ETA for fixes: initial PRs today, full rollout next week with extra canary checks.

Alex (SRE): I'll own 2 & 5. ETA: autoscaler PR by EOD, alerts by tomorrow.

Nora (Customer Success): I'll coordinate customer follow-ups and schedule the technical review with the impacted customers for next Tuesday.

Tim (oncall): Logged action items into IR-1722334 tracker. We'll run a blameless postmortem and share TL;DR with customers + engineering action plan. Closing warroom but keep thread pinned for follow-ups.

Maria (Support): Thanks everyone. I'll update tickets and close customer-facing items after the postmortem notes are ready.

Sasha (runtime): Noted — attaching a short repro artifact and heap sample link: s3://internal/ir-1722334/heap-samples/ (internal only).

Alex (SRE): Follow-up: confirm whether canary used quantized model with different memory footprint than stable; if so we should change the canary TTL to longer and simulate higher load before promotion.

Tim (oncall): Agreed. Thanks team. Will schedule postmortem doc and assign owners per action items.
